caveats: Every area range for sale, rent, yield and land is ESTIMATE; only individual comps are listing evidence.
Listing dates were not shown; comps are as at the retrieval date 13/11/2026 and are asking prices, not sales.
No regional NSW yield figures were found in CBRE, Colliers, JLL, Knight Frank, Opteon or HTW public pages; those cover Sydney or national only.
No rents were shown on leased listing pages; rents are estimates except Moree, Gunnedah, Cardiff and Thornton income figures.
No published serviced industrial lot prices were found (Tamworth Global Gateway Park, Dubbo Westview: price on application).

Several portal pages (commercialrealestate.com.au and realcommercial.com.au search pages for Dubbo, Orange, Wagga Wagga, Port Macquarie, Maitland, Coffs Harbour) were blocked by the fetch permission system and not read.
Build costs are secondary guides, not Rawlinsons or Cordell directly.
